title: Wiggle Sort
description:
Given an integer array `nums`, reorder it such that `nums[0] = nums[2] <= nums[3]...`.

You may assume the input array always has a valid answer.
constraints: It is guaranteed that there will be an answer for the given input nums.
hints: Analyze the key properties of Wiggle Sort.
Formulate an optimal space-time trade-off approach.
